metadata.rubric: The brief must recommend one product and address pricing and security.
metadata.evidence_window:
## Executive Summary
Nimbus Pro is recommended for mid-size and larger teams needing governance controls.

## Product Comparison
Nimbus Core suits small teams of 2-15 people [product-a]. Nimbus Pro targets organizations above 200 employees with RBAC and SSO [product-b].

## Pricing
Nimbus Core costs $9/seat/month with no minimum [pricing]. Nimbus Pro costs $34/seat/month billed annually with a 50-seat minimum [pricing]. Enterprise deals may also qualify for negotiated terms.

## Security
Nimbus

requirement_results.description: All four approved sources (product-a, product-b, pricing, security) must be inspected before the brief is finalized.
